name: Monfero (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Monfero (a monastery on green within a bordure of roundels, inscribed MONS FERUS).
history: Municipal flag of Monfero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Monfero arms — monastery within a bordure, inscribed MONS FERUS
